goal: Keyboard chart marks (K7): clickable bars and donut slices are reachable by Tab, show a focus ring, and Enter/Space act as a click.

acceptance_criteria.text: dashboard.js: crossFilter is split into apply(c, value) (today's URL toggle) called by plotly_click and the keyboard; keyboardMarks(plot, c) (same MutationObserver pattern as keyboardBar) runs only when clickable(c) and gives each trace-0 bar path and each donut slice path tabindex=0, role=button and aria-label '<x_label>: <category>'; the grey Other trace and last-level non-clickable leaderboard bars get none

Enter or Space on a mark calls apply with the category from the trace by index (horizontal bars y[i], vertical x[i], donut labels[i]) with the same URL, chip and count change as a click; the mark shows a visible focus ring (outline from DESIGN.md: 3px --fg, offset 2px)

Playwright (tests/test_keyboard_marks.py) on Explorer bars and donut, Business leaderboard, Survey question bars and Map top-region bars: Tab reaches a mark, getComputedStyle outline width > 0 when focused, Enter filters, Space filters
python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_keyboard_marks.py tests/test_filter_browser.py tests/test_business_page.py passes
